title: The AFOREST Toolkit
welcome_lead: Seven tools to make your writing persuade.
meta_desc: KS3 English Language adventure on the AFOREST persuasive toolkit.
final_note: You can now use every letter of AFOREST in your writing.

walkthroughs.body_html: AFOREST = Alliteration, Facts, Opinions, Rhetorical questions, Emotive language, Statistics, Triplets. Memorise it.
Facts can be checked ('1 in 3 children skip breakfast'). Opinions are personal ('this is unacceptable'). Both persuade.
Emotive language ('helpless', 'devastated', 'cruel') stirs feeling so readers care enough to act.
